claims.content: The C2 JU manages the classification and exchange of track identity data to ensure accurate situational awareness.

goal.raw_text: The C2 JU manages the classification and exchange of track identity data to ensure accurate situational awareness.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU detects or initiates a track/point and makes it available for reporting on the interface.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU detects or initiates a track/point and makes it available for reporting on the interface.

claims.content: The C2 JU exchanges track identity data using the Identity field, and may also report Platform and Platform Activity fields to amplify the identity.

For each implemented field (Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Special Interest Indicator), the JU accepts all defined values for retransmission and operator appreciation when assuming reporting responsibility ($R^2$) for a previously-reported track.

If the JU holds locally derived data that differs from accepted retransmission values (and is not No Statement), the JU reports the locally derived data, except for non-NS data received from the controlling unit which must be retransmitted regardless.
The JU manages IFF/SIF data to ensure commonality, using J7.5 messages with action values such as Clear (ACT=0), Difference Report (ACT=1), Update Request (ACT=2), or Special Code (ACT=3).
The JU applies transmission filters based on Environment, Identity, Geographic area, Special Processing, and Simulation status to determine if a track should be inhibited from transmission.

If the track is involved in an exercise, the C2 JU sets the Exercise Indicator in the J3 track messages to distinguish it from other live tracks; only tracks with standard identity of Friend can be modified by the exercise identity.

If the track is simulated (not derived from sensor data but for training/test), the C2 JU sets the Simulation Indicator in the J2 and J3 messages; simulated tracks are not correlated with live tracks and may be filtered.

If a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, or if the NPS Indicator is set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, or if a Drop Track message is received, or if Geodetic Position Quality is 0, the C2 JU assumes reporting responsibility of the inactive unit and reports it as a track with Identity set to Friend.

If correlation is not found for a received J2 PPLI report, the C2 JU integrates it into its surveillance database; if no subsequent J2 messages are received and no local data exists, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU.

If position or other data in a PPLI meets decorrelation criteria, the C2 JU decorrelates the PPLI and local track data, initiates a new surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number, and reports PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator as No Statement.
Track identity data is exchanged using the Identity field, with Platform and Platform Activity fields optionally reported to amplify identity information.

When assuming reporting responsibility (R²) for a previously-reported track, the C2 JU accepts all defined field values for Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator for retransmission and operator appreciation.

If the C2 JU holds locally derived data that differs from accepted retransmission values (and is not No Statement), it reports the locally derived data, except for non-NS data received from the controlling unit which must be retransmitted regardless.
The Special Interest Indicator set to value 1 shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
Simulated tracks are indicated by setting the Simulation Indicator in J2 and J3 messages, and simulated tracks are not correlated with live tracks.
The most current IFF/SIF data shall be reported, with the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator set based on whether codes match those received in J2 messages.
If locally derived IFF/SIF data differs from IFF/SIF data being reported in the PPLI message, the locally derived data shall be reported.
